title: diiriyime xaganah digloytah
intro: naharsi ayroorah addat qusba ayyunti, kedo inki adda mannowteh sugte maqar le buxaaxil, sittin geyit axawah tan. too sittin gey gano tekke wak, xalootitte Qur'aanak galitte fan qagte. too ummatta miyyak sugteeh, maca tekkeeh ken buxaaxi kee caxâ mirih caxaaxuwi?
clues: Nanu dirab cuso neh teceeh tan maqar le aracal sugne.
Nanu feerayso-wag ummattak sugne, uxih ninni xagana diggalsimeh.
Nanu farmoyti qagitak bicsenno usug nee fan yemeeteek widiril, takkay immay ni ekraaro raddeh.
Ni palmih coox Yallih amril yiggiriqqeh, kay xiqtoh asta kinni.
Nanu ninni buxaaxik diiriyeenih, qigdu madaara, ninni sadi digaalah.
Qur'aanak gaaboynah mafdagal nee galab xageeh, ni aydaadi sittin gey yaggileh yan marah takkaawisso kinni.

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: ken buxaaxik marroowa kee ken diiriyo
trial.answer: ken buxaaxik marroowa kee ken diiriyo

arabic: مَا قَطَعْتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَآئِمَةً عَلَىٰٓ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِىَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
verse: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allāh and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient. (59:5)
